import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        print(pow(p, p - 1, MOD))
    elif k == 1:
        print(pow(p, p, MOD))
    else:
        sz = 1
        pos = k % p
        while pos != 1:
            pos = (pos * k) % p
            sz += 1
        cnt = (p - 1) // sz
        print(pow(p, cnt, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
